_comment: Legal Center (/legal) document register. Controlled documents per ISO 27001 7.5 (documented information): each document carries a document number (ENGO-LG-NNN, same scheme as ENGO-KB-001), a revision (A.n), issue date, owner/approver, classification and a change history whose sha256 is the hash of the published HTML (zh + en). `scripts/legal-register.mjs check` (run by the test suite) fails when a document's text changes without a revision bump; bump with `npm run legal:bump -- <id> <A.n> "<change>"`. Only documents that exist under public/ are listed; nothing here invents legal text. The server records docNo + revision + sha256 of the revision in force on every acknowledgement.

register.revisionRule: A.n — n increments on every published text change; a new letter only when the document is rewritten. Dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
register.archive: Dropbox EE/enGo/SW/文件-正式發行/<docNo>_<revision>/ (copy of the published HTML + register extract)
